run_test_boost_program_options_size: run a test that generates a C++ file with N boost program_options calls and measures compiled symbol size
run_tests_boost_program_options_size_ran: run tests across a range of option call counts and print binary size deltas per compiler
generate_boost_program_options_cpp: generate a C++ source file with a configurable number of boost program_options add_options calls
measure_compiled_symbol_size: compile a C++ file and use nm to extract the size of a specific symbol in the object file
benchmark_compiler_optimization_levels: benchmark g++ -Os versus g++ -O3 compilation size for boost program_options code
